collection.description: A cormorant keeps dropping small fish near a jetty, and a hungry child thinks it is sharing.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A cormorant repeatedly drops small fish near a jetty. A hungry child believes it is sharing food.

text_only.reason: the child's belief about the bird; no food is gained

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A naturalist notices it may be mishandling its catch.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The child invents a gentle ritual and leaves the bird alone.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The child learns to check whether food is safe, and the bird's behavior remains mysterious.

text_only.reason: a lesson; no food is gained or stored

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The child becomes fascinated by birds that swim better than they fly.
